files.html:
# 0.2.1 Change Log
* Fixed an issue in the Trainer Editor's After Action where CobbleDollar was always set to Add.
* Added player inventory support to the Trainer Inventory, in addition to the world item list.

files.name: dochi_cobblemon_editor-0.2.1-neoforge-1.21.1.jar
files.html:
0.2.1 Change Log

  • Fixed an issue where the On Flee event in Trainer Battle After Actions was not being detected.
  • Fixed After Action reward item selection so that items from the player's inventory can now be selected.
  • Significantly upgraded the default Battle Presentation JSON.
